changelog: Added FlareFlow drama downloader with automated fMP4 stream decryption, browser token sync, and smart lock detection.
Fixed iQIYI and IYF episode grid alignment and initial selection state.
Enhanced Pinterest video downloader with clearer profile URL error guidance.

Optimized asset file size and download buffer chunk sizes for faster downloads, added desktop shortcut/icon option to Inno Setup installer, implemented silent background installation (UAC bypass), and fixed Windows taskbar icon display.
Fixed yt-dlp missing error ([WinError 2]) by downloading dependencies dynamically and adding to environment PATH. Upgraded branding logo and icon sharpness.
Updated to v1.1.2 with fixed software update checking mechanism.
Integrated startup welcome sound configuration (Piseth Khmer Voice / Custom Upload).
Enhanced modern Dark/Light theme swapping with premium animations.
Optimized all-in-one downloader support for YouTube, Facebook, Tiktok, Douyin, Instagram, Pinterest, Youku, IYF, DramaBox, Reelshort, Dramabite, Anime, and Dailymotion.
Improved responsive UI layout and alignment adaptation for desktop screens.
